name: Temple of Preah Vihear
description: Perched on the edge of a 525-metre cliff in Cambodia's Dângrêk Mountains, Preah Vihear is an 11th-century Khmer temple to Shiva that looks out over the plains far below. Instead of the usual east-facing plan, its sanctuaries stretch along an 800-metre north–south axis, linked by long staircases and stone pavements. Its remote setting has kept the carvings remarkably well preserved.
